title: Ukraine 40th Marine Brigade Deploys Barracuda Naval Drones Against Russian Positions in Kherson Region — Day 1,557
detail: On May 31, 2026 (Day 1,557), Ukraine's 40th Separate Marine Brigade released footage confirming the combat deployment of Barracuda maritime drones successfully destroying Russian positions, fortifications, and shelters in the Kherson region. The Barracuda is a Ukrainian-developed maritime drone designed for shallow-water operations in the Dnipro River delta and surrounding wetlands — extending Ukraine's naval drone warfare from the Black Sea campaign to riverine combat. Russian forces hold the left (east) bank and Ukrainian forces hold the right (west) bank of the Dnipro in Kherson Oblast, with the two sides separated by the river and its delta. Barracuda drones navigate the shallow waterways to strike Russian positions near the waterline. The deployment demonstrates Ukraine's continued expansion of asymmetric drone warfare capabilities on multiple fronts.

media.caption: Ukraine's 40th Marine Brigade deploys Barracuda maritime drones to destroy Russian positions and shelters in Kherson region — expanding riverine drone warfare

title: Russian Military Losses Reach ~1,364,060 Cumulative Since Feb 24, 2022 — 1,560 Eliminated in Past 24 Hours on Day 1,557
detail: Ukraine's General Staff reported on May 31, 2026 (Day 1,557 of Russia's full-scale invasion) that Russia's cumulative military personnel losses reached approximately 1,364,060 killed and wounded — an increase of approximately 1,560 over the previous 24-hour period. The front line saw 253 combat engagements. The Pokrovsk sector (Donetsk Oblast) remained the hottest axis with 52 enemy assault actions repelled. Kharkiv city and 17 surrounding settlements were attacked, with 1 killed and 1 injured. Kherson city's Korabelnyi district was shelled at approximately 09:00, wounding 3. Zaporizhzhia Oblast: the village of Komyshuvakha was struck by drone (1 killed, 1 injured); Russia launched 976 total attacks across 55 Zaporizhzhia settlements over 24 hours. Fighting also continued along the Lyman, Kostiantynivka, Huliaipole, and Kherson directions. The average daily Russian loss rate has remained above 1,000 per day through May 2026; Commander-in-Chief Syrskyi previously confirmed 141,500+ losses in 2026 alone (83,000+ irreversible).

media.caption: Russian military losses reach ~1,364,060 since Feb 24, 2022 — 1,560 eliminated in 24 hours; 253 combat engagements; Pokrovsk sector sees 52 enemy assaults on Day 1,557

title: Ukraine Front-Line May 31: 253 Combat Engagements; Pokrovsk, Kharkiv, Zaporizhzhia, Kherson All Under Fire
detail: On May 31, 2026 (Day 1,557), Ukraine's General Staff recorded 253 combat engagements over a 24-hour period, maintaining the high-intensity pace of late May 2026. The Pokrovsk sector (Donetsk Oblast) remained the principal axis of Russian effort with 52 enemy assault actions repelled. Kharkiv city and 17 surrounding settlements sustained attacks, killing 1 civilian and injuring 1. Kherson city's Korabelnyi district received artillery shelling at approximately 09:00, injuring 3 civilians. Zaporizhzhia Oblast: village of Komyshuvakha was struck by drone (1 killed, 1 injured), and Russian forces launched a total of 976 attacks across 55 Zaporizhzhia settlements over the day — reflecting a surge in shelling intensity in the southern sector. Lyman, Kostiantynivka, and Huliaipole directions also saw sustained contact. The pace reflects Russia's continued attrition-focused offensive strategy: gradual daily advances at high cost, with daily casualties averaging 1,430–1,560 personnel.

media.caption: 253 combat engagements on Day 1,557 — Pokrovsk sector sees 52 enemy assaults; Kharkiv, Kherson, Zaporizhzhia all under sustained fire
